summary: Admit comparative improvement findings as idempotent repository-scoped ticket DAGs

delivery.outcome: Deliver idempotent repository-scoped comparative finding admission and first-class ticket DAG dependency persistence in Planfile.
nonGoals: Do not allocate target repository governance worktrees directly inside Planfile before admission.
Do not modify external sync provider caches or unrelated store internals.

architecture.decision: Implement ComparativeFindingsAdapter over Planfile.create_ticket_deduplicated, Store.update_ticket with expected_updated_at CAS, and planfile_graph DAG validation and execution layering.
interfaceChanges: TicketCreate and TicketUpdate expose blocked_by, blocks, parent, children, group, acceptance_criteria, and files
architecture.rollback: Revert the comparative findings module and API model extensions through an independent publication PR.

validation.evidence: Adapter reuses create_ticket_deduplicated, current store allocation, GitHub sync mapping, and expected_updated_at CAS.
Stable dedupe key binds repository, capability, intent, policy_version, and requirement fingerprint; refreshed evidence appends an occurrence while changed requirements create a distinct ticket.
blocked_by, blocks, parent, and children persist via Python and REST APIs and validate DAG acyclicity and layers through planfile_graph.
Proposals require SERVICE/FEATURE/BUGFIX classification with reason, target scope, prerequisites, acceptance test, fresh target HEAD, rollback, and deferred governance ticket allocation.
Tests verify twice-imported finding, concurrent refresh CAS conflict, obsolete target HEAD rejection, terminal recurrence, sync idempotency, dependency failure, no-change, and dry-run.
